newsitem.title: USA: Ben & Jerry's CEO Robert Holland resigns.
newsitem.headline: Ben & Jerry's CEO Robert Holland resigns.

text.p: Ben & Jerry's Homemade Inc said Friday that Robert Holland will resign as president and chief executive, effective October 31.
Holland replaced the ice cream maker's founders in February 1995, when the company moved from a "founder-led" system to a more professional management structure, Ben & Jerry's said.

"Bob arrived just when we needed him to help straighten out our operations, get our new plant up and running, start our international business and launch our new sorbet line. We are very grateful for his contribution," said Ben Cohen, Ben & Jerry's chairman.

"At this juncture a change appears appropriate. When you couple the marketplace challenges with the predictably tough demands associated with succeeding founders, the need for accelerated succession is clear," Holland said.
Holland wil remain as a director through the June 1997 annual meeting, the company said.
A subcommittee of the board will immediately begin the serach for a new chief executive, the company said.
Bruce Bowman, senior director of operations, has been given the additional title of chief operating officer on an interim basis. Bowman will oversee day-to-day management of the company.
